gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with pathologically confirmed recurrent high-grade glioma (including grade III and IV, excluding brainstem tumors) after standard therapy.

candidate_evidence.quote: Obitazidine Fumarate Enteric-coated Pellet Capsules (SM-1) in Combination With Temozolomide in Subjects With Refractory or Recurrent Gliomas: Phase I Trial

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: SM-1 Combined With Temozolomide in Subjects With Refractory or Recurrent High-Grade Gliomas

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetic (PK) parameters (including Cmax, Tmax, AUC0-t, AUC0-∞, t1/2, CL/F, Vd/F) and pharmacodynamic (PD) markers (e.g., target engagement, immune cell kinetics, tumor-related biomarkers) will be analyzed using blood/CSF samples collected at pre-specified time points.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: pharmacodynamic (PD) markers (e.g., target engagement, immune cell kinetics, tumor-related biomarkers) will be analyzed using blood/CSF samples collected at pre-specified time points.

role_evidence.quote: The core focus is to screen the optimal clinical dose regimen of SM-1, fully monitor adverse reactions, and preliminarily observe the anti-tumor efficacy of the combination regimen.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational procaspase-3 agonist/activator (SM-1, obitazidine fumarate enteric-coated pellet capsules), oral

role_evidence.quote: Temozolomide is administered orally once daily at bedtime on an empty stomach at a dose of 150 mg/m² or 200 mg/m², as determined by the investigator, on Days 1 to 5 of each 28-day cycle.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: unspecified tumour-related PD biomarkers in blood/CSF

source_quote.quote: pharmacodynamic (PD) markers (e.g., target engagement, immune cell kinetics, tumor-related biomarkers) will be analyzed using blood/CSF samples collected at pre-specified time points.

coder_notes: Registered intervention is a single combined entry 'SM-1,TMZ'; split into two rows using the names in the arm label. SM-1 is the only investigational agent, temozolomide 150-200 mg/m2 d1-5 q28 is standard backbone (soc_backbone). Moiety name: official title says 'Obitazidine Fumarate' but the brief summary says 'Obitrexate Fumarate'; obitazidine (from the official title, fumarate salt removed) used; keyword describes it as 'Procaspas-3 agonist' (no mechanism sentence stated, so stated_antitumour_mechanism null). Population: recurrent high-grade glioma grade III and IV with glioblastoma named in conditions -> mixed_glioma_gbm_named; grade IV without IDH -> historical. PK/PD in blood/CSF -> CSF PK counts as tumour_pk yes (blood/CSF combined, sample split unstated); PD 'target engagement' markers planned -> yes. stdAges include CHILD but inclusion requires age >= 18.
